result.description:
Salary: $67,510 to $72,000
Location: Darwin / Batchelor, NT

About Us:
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer:
We are supporting a reliable cleaning services business (ABN 19 104 515 123) based in Darwin and surrounding areas, operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, aged care, and Airbnb cleaning. The business is known for quality service, attention to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction. With a growing team and service locations across multiple sites, they are seeking a General Clerk to support daily administration, customer enquiries, scheduling assistance, records management, data entry, filing, and general office support.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain business records, including customer details, bookings, invoices, and service documentation.
- Handle incoming communications (emails, calls, messages) and respond to customer enquiries regarding bookings and services.
- Enter and update data in systems and spreadsheets, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
- Assist with preparing routine reports such as schedules, service records, attendance, and stock usage.
- Maintain records of cleaning equipment and supplies issued to staff.
- Support document management, including scanning, filing, and organising office and compliance paperwork.
- Assist with rostering and scheduling cleaning staff across various sites.
- Provide accurate information to customers and site contacts about services and bookings.
- Perform general receptionist duties, including answering calls and directing enquiries.
- Support stock control by tracking usage and assisting with ordering.
- Assist management with general administrative tasks to support daily operations.

Selection Criteria
- Previous clerical, administration, receptionist, customer service, or office support experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
- Good computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, calendars, data entry, and document management.
- Clear and professional communication skills when dealing with customers, staff, suppliers, and site contacts.
- Ability to organise tasks, follow instructions, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities.
- Ability to handle confidential business, client, and staff information appropriately.
- Willingness to work in a busy service-based business supporting cleaning teams across multiple sites.
- Understanding of workplace health and safety administration, stock records, or service scheduling will be highly regarded.

Required Experience and Qualifications
- AQF Certificate II or III in Business, Administration, Clerical Services, or a related field is preferred.
- At least one year of relevant clerical, administrative, receptionist, or office support experience
- Experience in cleaning, facilities, hospitality, accommodation, aged care, or other service-based industries will be highly regarded.
- Full working rights in Australia are required.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, organised, and detail-oriented General Clerk to join us and help support the smooth day-to-day administration of our cleaning services business.

To apply, please submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the General Clerk role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a reliable and growing cleaning services business that values quality, care, safety, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications close: 04 August 2026

Applications will be reviewed as they arereceived, andtherefore may result in theroleclosing early if the right applicant is found.

Make a meaningful difference with Buderim Private Hospital

As one of the Sunshine Coast's largest hospitals, we provide a comprehensive range of surgical and medical services using the latest technology. This includes emergency, maternity, intensive care, cardiovascular, obstetric andgynaecology, urology, cancer care, general medicine, renal and respiratory services,orthopaedicand mental health care, among many others. With a deep connection to the Sunshine Coast that's 40 years in the making, Buderim Private Hospital partners with our patients to deliverpersonalisedone-on-one care from the heart and make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

An integral part of our team, as aFood Services Assistant, you'll be encouragedto grow, develop and feel empowered to make the everyday easier for the people we care so passionately about. Let's make a meaningful difference, together! 

Your part in our Buderim Hospital team

As part of our Food Services team, you willbe responsible forproviding high-quality service delivery to all customers including patients,staffand visitors. You willbe responsible forbasic meal preparation, portioning and serving of hot and cold meals, meal delivery and distribution, and cleaning. In addition to this you will: 

Assist with the timely assembly, delivery and collection of meals to patients and work collaboratively with clinical staff to ensure all patients with special dietary requirements-changes are addressed and met 

Act as quality control to ensure all meals are presented to a high standard and are appropriate for each patient, escalating issues where required 

Ensure a high standard of hygiene and safety throughout the food services department that complies with the hospital food safety program 

Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of HACCP principles in accordance with the hospital's food safety program

What makes a difference for us?

Flexibility to work across all shifts - mornings, afternoons, evenings, and weekends 

Previousexperience in a food service or hospitality team environment, preferably within the Healthcare industry.

Demonstrated understanding and competencies in manual handling training, chemical use,hand hygieneand food safety 

Ability to work well in a team and support a positive team environment 

Basic numeracy, literacy, verbalcommunicationand interpersonal skills including ability to read, measure accurately and perform basic math skills 

Willingness to obtain required vaccinations in line with hospitals infection control requirements, as well as undergo national criminal history check and functionalassessment

What makes a difference for you? 

NFP Salary Packaging: Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum. To learn more about this benefit watch the video via the following link: Salary Packaging Explained

Flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance 

A recognition and rewards platform, providing employee discounts at hundreds of retailers, including everyday expenses, holidays, health insurance, annual awards celebration, wellbeing and employee assistance programs 

12 weeks paid parental leave and 2 weeks paid partner leave, available after 6 months service, in addition to the government scheme 

Diversity and inclusive leave, offering paid gender affirmation leave and cultural leave options (paid and unpaid) for those who may celebrate Lunar New Year, Diwali, Ramadan, NAIDOC weeks and other significant cultural events 

Career development opportunities to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

A positive and inclusive team based on respect, shared standards, strong values and a commitment to serving others 

We'd love you to be part of our UnitingCare family 

By joining our Hospitals, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. The second-largest Queensland employer, we're a proud not-for-profit with more than 17,500 staff and 9, 000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, and have been leading by example for more than 100 years. Our team are compassionate, inclusive and committed to the work we do, helping people live life in all its fullness. 

Child safe, Child friendly 

UnitingCare is committed to being a Child Safe, Child Friendly organisation and will: 

provide welcoming, safe and nurturing services for children 

implement measures to prevent child abuse and neglect within our services 

appropriately and immediately address child abuse and neglect if it does occur 

abide by the Child Safe Standards and adhere to the Reportable Conduct Scheme 

Diversity & Inclusion 

Our approach is simple - everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees no matter their sex, race, culture, sexual orientation, disability or gender identity. Demonstrating our commitment to reconciliation and building long-term employment opportunities for First Nations peoples, UnitingCare strongly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants for this position. 

Safe workplace 

We work hard to make our services welcoming and safe for every person. We are united in keeping children, young people and the elderly safe from harm, within our services, workplaces and the communities we support. We are committed to speaking up loudly for their safety. 

Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed in creating services and workplaces that are welcoming and safe for every person. We work together to protect children, young people, adults and the elderly from harm within our services and the communities we support. We speak up for their safety to ensure their voices are heard. Our recruitment and workplace practices reflect our dedication in preventing abuse, harm and exploitation across UnitingCare.    Click here to Apply now →

About the Business
Robust IT Services is a dynamic and growing IT solutions provider based in South Geelong, specialising in managed IT services, infrastructure design, cloud solutions, network security, vulnerability testing, data security, and comprehensive business IT support. With a strong focus on delivering responsive, reliable, and forward-thinking technological solutions, the company has built a solid reputation for helping businesses of all sizes optimise their IT environments, mitigate risks, and drive operational success. Guided by values of innovation, quality, professionalism, and customer-centric service, Robust IT fosters a collaborative, supportive workplace culture where team members are encouraged to solve challenges, continuously develop their skills, and contribute to meaningful client outcomes in a fast-paced yet balanced environment.
About the Position
The ICT Support Technician plays a key hands-on role within Robust IT Services by providing day-to-day technical support to end-users and clients, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues, and ensuring the reliable operation of IT systems and infrastructure. This position is essential for maintaining high service standards, minimising downtime, and delivering excellent customer support across the company’s internal operations and client environments.
Key Responsibilities
Provide timely technical support and assistance to end-users, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and peripheral issues.
Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade computer systems, operating systems, applications, and network components.
Respond to user inquiries about IT problems and provide clear guidance and solutions.
Manage user accounts, permissions, and access in systems such as Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
Perform regular system backups, updates, patches, and basic security maintenance.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues with printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals.
Maintain accurate documentation of support activities, procedures, and asset records.
Collaborate with the team on IT projects, system improvements, and client support initiatives.
Ensure compliance with service level agreements and quality standards.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 1 year of experience in IT support, helpdesk, or a similar technical role.
Strong technical skills in troubleshooting hardware and software issues, Microsoft environments (including Office 365 and Active Directory), networking fundamentals, and remote support tools.
Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
Ability to work independently and as part of a small team in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The Client  

Northcote Auto Careis an automotive service and repair workshop based in Northcote, VIC, specialising in vehicle diagnostics, mechanical repairs, and routine servicing.  

They are seeking an experienced Motor Mechanic to join their team in Northcote, VIC. 

 

 

The Role 

The Motor Mechanic is responsible for delivering diagnostic, repair, and maintenance services across a range of vehicles, ensuring all work meets technical specifications, safety standards, and customer requirements. 

This is a full-time position with an annual salary set at $82,500 plus superannuation.  

 

The Responsibilities 

Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, testing equipment, and technical procedures 

Inspect vehicles and assess system performance across engines, transmissions, suspension, steering, and braking systems 

Perform servicing and maintenance tasks including oil changes, brake servicing, and system adjustments 

Dismantle, repair, and reassemble engine components, transmissions, and associated mechanical systems 

Replace defective parts and components in accordance with manufacturer specifications and repair standards 

Conduct testing and verification of repairs to ensure functionality, safety, and compliance 

Interpret technical manuals, service documentation, and repair guides to support accurate diagnostics and repairs 

Maintain records of servicing, repairs, and parts usage in line with workshop and compliance requirements 

Identify additional faults or service requirements and communicate findings to supervisors or customers 

Ensure all work is completed in accordance with workplace safety procedures and automotive standards 

Maintain workshop tools, equipment, and work areas in safe and operational condition 

Coordinate with team members to ensure efficient workflow and timely completion of jobs 

 

 

The Requirements:	 

Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent qualification 

Certificate IV in Automotive Mechanical Diagnosis and/or Diploma of Automotive Technology highly regarded. 

At least 15 months of motor mechanical experience in a commercial workshop setting 

At least 15 months experience diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults across vehicle systems 

Minimum 15 months using OBD-II diagnostic tools, workshop equipment and vehicle service information. 

Minimum 15 months experience performing servicing, maintenance, and repair of engines, transmissions, and braking systems 

Must have at least 15 months experience working with Asian and European car vehicles 

Must have at least 15 months motor mechanical experience with AWDs, 4WDs, 

Must have at least 15 months experience with Hybrid vehicles 

Ability to interpret technical manuals, specifications, and repair documentation 

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify and resolve mechanical issues efficiently 

Good understanding of workplace safety procedures and automotive compliance standards 

Ability to work independently and manage workload in a workshop environment 

Good communication skills and ability to liaise with team members and customers 

Valid Driver’s Licence

result.description:
Tara Forklift Services has a vacancy for a Diesel Motor Mechanic at their business.

This is a permanent, full-time position.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

To qualify this position, you will have;

1) AQF Certificate III in Forklift Technology, or equivalent or relevant experience
or
2) AQF Certificate III Mechanical Trade, or equivalent or relevant experience
minimum 5 years’ experience

3) Prior servicing, diagnostics and hydraulic experience.

4) Demonstrated understanding of electrical systems.

5) Diagnose any problems with the forklifts or equipment by using scanning tools and computers

6) Repairs and replacement of defective parts with reference to service manuals

7) Completing scheduled services to ensure customer requirements and service agreements are upheld and to ensure the safety of the
customer’s equipment

8) Inspect and perform routine check-ups of key components including engine, steering, transmission, suspension, and brakes

9) Repair damaged parts, units, malfunctions or deficiencies with the forklift or equipment

10) Test drive equipment to see if the fault has been rectified

Remuneration/Salary

$75,000 to $85,000 per annum

Remuneration will reflect current market conditions and industry award rates. To be discussed with the successful applicant.

Application

Expressions of interest and applications will be accepted for at least 1 month from placement of this advertisement.
